fusions.name: Bolas Swing
fusions.desc: Slings a stone on a line at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Trapdoor Lunge
fusions.desc: Bursts from a burrow in a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it, stuns each enemy for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tunnel Under
fusions.desc: You drop into a burrow and come up at a spot up to 6 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Moored to Flagstone
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
